A dictator is a political leader who possesses absolute power . A dictatorship is defined as a state ruled by a dictator. [ 1 ] [ 2 ] The word originated as the title of a Roman dictator elected by the Roman Senate to rule the republic in times of emergency . [ 2 ] Like the terms " tyrant " and " autocrat ", dictator came to be used almost exclusively as a non-titular term for oppressive rule. In modern usage, the term dictator is generally used to describe a leader who holds or abuses an extraordinary amount of personal power.
